description: This file implements utility functions for logging and filename processing within the Thunder::Core namespace. It includes functions to extract filename from a path and to generate formatted log messages, as well as a platform-specific function to get the program name.

methods.name: const char * FileNameOnly(const char fileName[])
methods.description: Extracts the filename from a given path, handling both UNIX and Windows style separators.

methods.name: string LogMessage(const TCHAR fileName[],const uint32_t lineNumber,const TCHAR * message)
methods.description: Creates a formatted log message string including filename, line number, and message content.

methods.name: const std::string & GetProgramName()
methods.description: On Windows, retrieves the executable's filename, caching the result for subsequent calls.

ctags.name: LogMessage
ctags.pattern: /^    string LogMessage(const TCHAR fileName[], const uint32_t lineNumber, const TCHAR* message)$/
ctags.signature: (const TCHAR fileName[],const uint32_t lineNumber,const TCHAR * message)
